decision: The complete upstream change adds pointer-events none to the modern hidden panel. Owned legacy source instead controls the attached OverlayRef pane because an empty option group gives the hidden pane height and the pane itself can intercept the target. The local guarded policy records prior inline value and priority, disables the hidden pane, restores only its own unchanged override on visibility, respects distinguishable external changes, and releases state on detach. The inline write has an unavoidable same-value ambiguity. This is a source decision; bounded artifact observations are separately identified in the review.
